name: Imperial Pike Guards
headerMeta: Heroic era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 240 leadership · Honour Unit
pitch: A high-DPS pike line that trades survivability for lethality, oneshots units that charge it and excels in advance-based gameplay. Its weakness is exposure to crowd control — retreat and disengage if you lose control.

doctrines.name: Epic Polearm Doctrine (+80 piercing dmg, +120 piercing AP)

veterancy.label: Full Top
veterancy.body: For DPS — oneshots scaling with charge speed

battleRole.positioning: Charge in or X-move in to close to melee range. Position to force enemy engagement on your terms — the unit does more damage the faster the enemy is, so bait charges. {1}
battleRole.tips: Advance near melee range and wait for hits to stack, then press 3 (Charge). Kill count reduces Advance CD (sometimes to zero). {1} First tick of Advance can do insane damage — the mechanic scales with your unit's speed at impact. {1} Don't hesitate to disengage from CC or Advance if you can save the unit. {1}
